note: House League items, batch 2 of 4 (DC-H2): six Charms on existing rule pieces, written and landed together by E18-C09. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: +1 Mult for every strike thrown since it was bought: each strike adds a trophy after the frame banks, so a strike counts from the next frame on. Kept for the attempt; selling it loses its trophies.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A glass case that fills with small trophies; the count shows on the card and the new trophy lands after the bank.

design.trigger: +25 Value for each corner pin (rack positions 7 and 10) knocked down in the frame, whatever its material.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: Billiard pockets at the two back corners of the rack diagram; each lit pocket counts.

design.trigger: +10 Mult in a match's second frame when the match score is still under half its target.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A scoreboard clock in its last minute; it lights only when behind in frame 2, showing the score against half the target.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a spare where no roll curved: the straight shot that picks up what is left.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A dustpan sweeping a straight line; it shows the frame's rolls were all straight.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a strike thrown with the House Ball.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1. The Proprietor's first-clear reward once E22-L01 declares gate.proprietor_cleared.
design.presentation_needs: The House chalkboard special; it shows the House Ball when every roll used it.

design.trigger: +2 Mult for each of the front three pins (rack positions 1, 2 and 3) knocked down, up to +6.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: Three shields at the front of the rack diagram; each falls flat when its pin does.
